newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea's Hyundai Elec, nine others apply for IPOs.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea's Hyundai Elec, nine others apply for IPOs.

text.p: South Korea's Securities Supervisory Board said on Tuesday that Hyundai Electronics Industrial Co Ltd and nine other companies had applied to hold initial public offerings in November.

The Securities Supervisory Board said in a statement that if all the offerings were approved, they would add 453.96 billion won to the stock market's capitalisation. As of September 2, the market's capitalisation was 992.67 billion won.
Decisions on the applications will be made in October. If approved, the shares will be listed in November at the earliest.
The following companies applied to publicly list their shares, but the SSB said the number of shares and/or the prices were subject to change:
Hyundai Electronics, a unit of the Hyundai Group, applied to offer 10 million shares at 20,000 won per share.
Samsung Engineering Co Ltd, a unit of the Samsung Group
Kukdong City Gas Co Ltd applied for 1.8 million shares at 22,000 won per share.
Kuk Dong Corp, a textile wholesaler, applied for 360,000 shars at 15,000 won per share.
Sewon Chemical Co Ltd, a chemical products manufacturer, applied for 441,176 shares at 17,000 won per share.
Muhak Alcohol Co Ltd, a distillery, applied for 260,000 shares at 14,000 won per share.
Dong Nam Chemical Industries Co Ltd, a chemical products manufacturer, applied for 280,000 shares at 15,000 won per share.
Sindoricoh Co Ltd, an office machinery manufacturer, applied for 2.88 million shares at 39,000 won per share.
Hankook Steel Co Ltd, an equipment manufacturer, applied for 300,000 shares at 18,000 won per share.
Fursys Inc, a furniture manufacturer, applied for 920,000 shares at 36,000 won per share.
